00049 FFTMagnitudeSelectionUGenInternal::FFTMagnitudeSelectionUGenInternal(UGen const& input, 
00050                                                                      FFTEngine const& fft, 
00051                                                                      const int overlap, 
00052                                                                      IntArray const& _bins) throw()
00053 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, _bins.length()-1),
00054     fftEngine(fft),
00055     fftSize(fftEngine.size()),
00056     fftSizeHalved(fftSize / 2), 
00057     overlap_(overlap < 1 ? 1 : overlap),
00058     hopSize(fftSize / overlap),
00059     overlapSize(fftSize - hopSize),
00060     maxNumBins(fftSizeHalved + 1),
00061     bins(_bins),
00062     inputBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, 1, true)),
00063     outputBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, 1, true)),
00064     bufferIndex(fftSize - hopSize),
00065     magnitudes(BufferSpec(bins.length(), 1, true)),
00066     outputSampleData(new float*[bins.length()])
00067 {
00068     ugen_assert(overlap == overlap_);   // should be > 0
00069     ugen_assert(bins.length() > 0);
00070     
00071     inputs[Input] = input;
00072 }
00073 
00074 FFTMagnitudeSelectionUGenInternal::~FFTMagnitudeSelectionUGenInternal()
00075 {
00076     delete [] outputSampleData;
00077 }
00078 
00079 inline static void splat(float *buffer, float value, int n)
00080 {
00081     ugen_assert(buffer != 0);
00082     ugen_assert(n > 0);
00083 
00084     while(n--)
00085         *buffer++ = value;
00086 }
00087 
00088 void FFTMagnitudeSelectionUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00089 {
00090     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00091     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00092     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00093     float* bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData();
00094     
00095     // get output pointers
00096     for(int channel = 0; channel < bins.length(); channel++)
00097     {
00098         outputSampleData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00099     }   
00100     
00101     
00102     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00103     {
00104         int bufferSamplesToProcess = fftSize - bufferIndex;
00105         
00106         if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00107         {                           
00108             memcpy(bufferSamples + bufferIndex, inputSamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00109             
00110             bufferIndex += numSamplesToProcess;
00111             inputSamples += numSamplesToProcess;
00112             numSamplesToProcess = 0;
00113         }
00114         else
00115         {
00116             numSamplesToProcess -= bufferSamplesToProcess;
00117                                     
00118             memcpy(bufferSamples + bufferIndex, inputSamples, bufferSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00119             
00120             bufferIndex += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00121             inputSamples += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00122             bufferSamplesToProcess = 0;
00123             
00124             fftEngine.fft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer, true);
00125             
00126             magnitudes = fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, 0, maxNumBins);
00127             FloatArray floatMag = magnitudes.toArray<float>(0).at(bins);
00128             magnitudes = Buffer(floatMag);
00129             
00130             if(overlap_ > 1)
00131             {
00132                 memcpy(inputBuffer.getData(), inputBuffer.getData() + hopSize, overlapSize * sizeof(float));
00133                 bufferIndex = fftSize - hopSize;
00134             }
00135             else
00136             {
00137                 bufferIndex = 0;
00138             }
00139         }
00140         
00141         const int outputSamplesToProcess = hopSize < blockSize ? hopSize : blockSize;
00142         
00143         for(int channel = 0; channel < bins.length(); channel++)
00144         {
00145             float magnitude = magnitudes.getSampleUnchecked(channel);
00146             
00147             splat(outputSampleData[channel], magnitude, outputSamplesToProcess);
00148             
00149             outputSampleData[channel] += outputSamplesToProcess;
00150         }   
00151         
00152     }
00153     
00154 }

00156 FFTMagnitudeSelection::FFTMagnitudeSelection(UGen const& input, 
00157                                              FFTEngine const& fft, 
00158                                              const int overlap, 
00159                                              IntArray const& bins) throw()
00160 {
00161     int overlapChecked = Bits::isPowerOf2(overlap) ? overlap : Bits::nextPowerOf2(overlap);
00162     
00163     ugen_assert(overlap != overlapChecked); // should be power of 2
00164 
00165     FFTMagnitudeSelectionUGenInternal *fftMag = new FFTMagnitudeSelectionUGenInternal(input.mix(), 
00166                                                                                       fft, 
00167                                                                                       overlapChecked, 
00168                                                                                       bins);
00169         
00170     initInternal(fftMag->getNumBins());
00171     generateFromProxyOwner(fftMag);
00172 }
